scripts.dev: npm run build -w @trao/pipeline && concurrently -n pipeline,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @trao/pipeline" "npm run dev -w @trao/api" "npm run dev -w @trao/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @trao/pipeline && concurrently -n pipeline,api -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @trao/pipeline" "npm run dev -w @trao/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trao/pipeline && npm run build -w @trao/api && npm run build -w @trao/web
